_doc: FB-23 per-object-KIND authored collision + shadow. Keyed by ObjectKindId. `collision` = sub-cell offsets [sdx,sdy] (0..COLLISION_SUBDIV-1 per cell) from the object's anchor-cell top-left sub-cell; blocks exactly those 8px sub-cells, superseding collisionFootprint. `shadow` = { shape, w, h, dx, dy, alpha } in px relative to the anchor cell top-left, superseding the heuristic shadow. Authored in the object-mode collision editor (?editor=object&kind=<id>), written by the dev save endpoint, committed (this is real game data, not gitignored staging). A kind with no entry keeps its legacy collisionFootprint/anchor-cell + heuristic shadow.
